prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic 4:5 high-fashion event portrait of two adult women at a luxury indoor evening party. The left adult woman has dark-brown shoulder-length soft waves and wears a black textured embroidered floral-lace mini dress with square neckline, layered gold necklace and delicate bracelet. The right adult woman has long flowing light-blonde waves and wears a black velvet evening gown with an embroidered lace panel, high neckline, cape-style short sleeves and minimal jewelry. Give both poised confident expressions and natural glam makeup. Use dim warm ambient lighting, dark wood and modern architecture, cocktail tables, softly blurred guests, bokeh and subtle neon accents. Preserve adult editorial fashion intent and use only approved identities.
